Bass One-Shot: a single bass hit or bass stab
a short isolated low-frequency bass sound
one bass note with a hit-like envelope
Bass Loop: a bass phrase repeating over multiple beats
a looped low-frequency musical bass pattern
Synth: an isolated synthesizer tone or synth stab
an electronic synthesizer sound rather than an acoustic instrument
Vocal Phrase: a short human vocal phrase or vocal one-shot
a spoken or sung isolated voice sample
FX: a designed sound effect rather than a musical instrument
a non-musical transition or special effect
Atmosphere: a continuous atmospheric texture or ambience
a sustained ambient drone or room atmosphere
Music Loop: a repeating musical loop or phrase
a multi-beat loop of musical material
a rhythmic or melodic pattern intended to repeat
Percussion: an isolated percussion hit such as a shaker, hand drum, or woodblock
an acoustic or electronic percussive sound
Hi-Hat: a short crisp metallic hat sound
OOD: a sound that does not fit any supported sample class
an unsupported or ambiguous audio recording
a full musical recording or unrelated sound
